text: 'a red tractor': concept art, 3 designs to choose from, then up to 0 rounds of notes

concept: A small stocky LEGO tractor with big rounded rear wheels, smaller front wheels, a boxy engine hood, and a simple cab with a curved-slope roof, standing still on a flat base. (changed: Removed any raised plow/loader attachment to keep silhouette compact and self-supporting; Made exhaust pipe a short fixed bar instead of a thin tall tube to keep it sturdy)
drawing the concept as an official LEGO set
turning the concept to see its side and back
working up 3 designs from the concept

design 3 of 3 reads best: 4/10. No cab/roll-bar structure — the tractor's signature red canopy and pillars are missing entirely; Wheels are square stud-faced plates rather than round tires; rear wheels not noticeably larger than front
